findings.description: The cycle guard (the `seen` set of visited exception ids) was removed from the `__cause__` chain walk. If the chain loops back on itself, the `while exc is not None` loop never terminates.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an exception whose `__cause__` chain is cyclic and contains no instance of `exception_cause_types`, e.g. `a.__cause__ = b; b.__cause__ = a`, which can be set manually or by `raise ... from`. Mechanism: `exc = exc.__cause__` alternates between the same exceptions, so the loop condition stays true and the loop never exits. Impact: the retry predicate hangs in an infinite loop and the process stalls at 100% CPU.
